subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: A shopkeeper sells an item for ₹450 after giving a 10% discount on the marked price. What is the marked price of the item?
solution: Let the marked price be x. Discount = 10% of x = 0.1x. Selling Price = x - 0.1x = 0.9x. Given 0.9x = 450, so x = 450 / 0.9 = 500. Topic (Profit, Loss and Discount) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
